verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's official CLI documents a `scrapingbee schedule` command for cron-based scheduled jobs. That is a first-party recurring-schedule capability, not a one-off action. But it is described only in a single line and labeled a gated advanced feature, with no detail on how it works or where jobs run. Missing for 10: detailed scheduling docs (cron syntax, job management, server-side vs. local execution), clarity on which plans unlock the gated feature, scheduling via the API or dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule scraping jobs to run automatically at specific times

citations.quote: `scrapingbee schedule` | Cron-based scheduled jobs; gated advanced feature.
